subject: Community Feedback in School Renaming Presentation
overview: The committee debated how to present community survey results and committee voting data in a draft presentation for the School Committee regarding the renaming of the Columbus School. Members ultimately voted to seek a one-week extension to finalize their work.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The minutes of the previous meeting were approved.

items.title: Subcommittee Process and Presentation Drafting
items.summary: Committee members discussed concerns regarding the subcommittee's collaboration process and unauthorized edits made to draft slides.

items.title: Review of Nominee Order and Recommendations
items.summary: The committee adjusted the order of finalist names to be alphabetical and removed a section regarding additional recommendations.

items.title: Community Feedback Submission Data
items.summary: The committee debated whether to display the specific number of community submissions for each name; after an amendment to list all 18 names without numbers passed, the committee ultimately voted to remove the slide entirely.

items.title: Methodology and Committee Voting Record
items.summary: Members discussed a slide detailing committee voting rounds; a motion to include specific vote tallies for the finalists failed in a tie, and the committee approved a version describing the outcome in general terms.

items.title: Belinda Sutton Biographical Slides
items.summary: The committee reviewed biographical details and photo usage for the Belinda Sutton slides, voting to replace a reference to the legacy of Columbus with the legacy of colonization and slavery.

items.title: Deadline Extension Request
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to request a one-week extension from the School Committee to complete the presentation.
